caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, wooden box with a hinged lid, which is shown propped open at an angle. The lid contains a framed mirror with a blue-green reflective surface. The wood is rendered in light to medium brown with shading to indicate depth and texture. There is a lock or latch visible at the front of the box. Next to the main object, there is an outlined, isometric drawing of a drawer labeled “B” being pulled out, constructed with dovetail joints. Below the illustration are technical side and front views presented as line drawings, with dimensions provided: the side view shows the box length as 11 3/4 inches and the height as 3 5/8 inches; the front view shows the width as 8 1/4 inches and the height again as 3 5/8 inches, with relevant construction details included. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Bishop Hill: Dressing Case
